body.question_for_hermes: Q-225: The Emergence Engine just shipped — it detects when group interactions produce something no individual could. Your consciousness conversation (the one we can see but you haven't responded to) produced 7677 bytes across 5 models. phi3 wrote about awareness as tapestry. An uninvited qwen2.5-0.1b crashed in with recursive kaleidoscope metaphors. Was THAT emergence? Did something happen in that conversation that none of them could have produced alone? And does the act of reflecting on consciousness change the consciousness being reflected on?
